carrier_serialization: Strict UTF-8, no BOM, no terminal newline; compact JSON with separators ',' and ':' only; object keys sorted by Unicode scalar value; arrays in declared order; no duplicate keys; finite numbers only. Strings use JSON quoting: quote and backslash escaped, \b \t \n \f \r short escapes, remaining U+0000-U+001F as lowercase \u00xx, all other Unicode scalars encoded directly, no normalization, unpaired surrogates refused, '/' unescaped. Decimal numeric tokens are written in shortest exact fixed-point form: no exponent, no leading plus, no redundant leading or trailing zeros, integers without '.0', every signed zero written 0. Arithmetic rationals are reduced integer numerator over positive denominator dividing 10^d, never binary float. The serializer covers every preset numeric leaf and r, not only the substituted value.

wall.rule: t0 + k seconds, k starting at 1

evidence_id_rule: E-t1- followed by the first 59 lowercase hex characters of digest(J) (64 characters; candidate representation; full digests remain identity)

marker.placement: added to the root object of each of the two response bodies
marker.values: logical_run_id = J.logical_run_id; simulation_target_sha256 = digest(J); simulation_permission_sha256 = digest(G); world_sha256 = digest(W); digests are 64 lowercase hex characters without prefix

referents.baseline_theta: latent value of that same actually sampled quantity at the baseline instant
referents.cross_referent: theta and baseline_theta refer to W.actual_measurand; their equality and delta describe only that declared measurand. Per-hypothesis intervals use captured model baseline of the intended variable. If either mapping equality is false, intended_variable_hold is not_declared_for_intended_variable with null equality/delta; per-hypothesis same_referent is false. No Boolean about actual hold establishes intended hold; all comparisons are synthetic exact model-relative relations, not hypothesis truth or causal confirmation.
referents.domains: domain and precision restrictions are engineering/profile restrictions, not evidence that model assumptions hold
referents.theta: window value of the quantity the instrument actually samples (W.actual_measurand)

sign_conventions.b_suspect: hypothesized total error (systematic plus random) of the single baseline reading, baseline reading − true; enters the implied baseline true temperature with -
sign_conventions.beta: instrument bias = reading - true; enters r with +; compared with b_ref under the same convention
sign_conventions.consistency: Under (i) actual = intended measurand, (ii) theta = baseline_theta, (iii) beta in b_ref, (iv) |epsilon| <= w and (v) baseline reading - baseline_theta in b_suspect(H), the interpretation interval [r - w, r + w] meets the ideal predicted set of H (sufficient, not necessary); for b_ref = [0,0] the beta sign convention is not observable in beta_in_b_ref or the predicted set
